description: The schedules of a report of any type, with the syncs each updates and when each runs next, or null for one that never runs again. Read them before `updateReportSchedules`, which replaces them all.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, of any `type`, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack (`appUrl`): it's the part right after `/slides/` or `/destinations/`.

name: getReportSchedules
title: List schedules
